verdicts.rationale: collections/create accepts TTL=-100 (negative value, physically meaningless) while alter_properties correctly rejects it with error code 1100 stating valid range [-1, 3155760000]. This is inconsistent parameter validation - create endpoint bypasses TTL range check that alter endpoint enforces. Negative TTL (except -1 for 'no expiration') has no physical meaning. This is a true validation gap in REST v2 create endpoint.
